title: (No AI) Spotify pulled 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from its recommendations
author: Emma Roth
content:
![Spotify’s logo](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/23951391/STK088_VRG_Illo_N_Barclay_4_spotify.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Spotify says it has removed more than 50 million songs considered AI-generated slop or spam from user recommendations over the past year. That's according to an [announcement on Tuesday](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-10-20/prioritizing-human-artistry/) that says Spotify has also made changes to its recommendation system to highlight more music made by human artists.

"Our editors hold the same standard and don't program content identified as slop or spam," Spotify says. "Since we made these changes, we've seen a marked decrease in listener concerns about this content showing up in recommendations."

Though Spotify has [stopped short](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/917109/spotify-starts-rolling-out-its-voluntary-ai-labels) of mandating labels on all AI tracks, [it launched an "AI Persona" badge for …](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/977815/spotify-ai-persona-label-recommendations)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/1014284/spotify-ai-slop-spam-songs-removed)

title: (No AI) Adobe Lightroom mobile can now open closed eyes in photos with a simple tap
author: Andrew Liszewski
content:
![A before and after photo showing open eyes added to a photo of a person with their eyes closed.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/lightroom1.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Adobe [announced yesterday](https://blog.adobe.com/en/publish/2026/10/19/give-your-photos-a-second-chance-with-open-eyes-in-lightroom-on-mobile) that the [mobile version of Lightroom](https://www.adobe.com/products/photoshop-lightroom/mobile.html), available for iOS, iPadOS, and Android, can now open closed eyes in photos using generative AI with just a single tap. When the app detects a person, or a group of people, have their eyes closed in a photo it will automatically present users with a new Open Eyes Quick Action that appears as an icon over the image providing easy access to the new feature.

Being able to easily save an otherwise great photo by opening a subject's eyes has been a feature in Adobe's Photoshop Elements for nearly a decade, but as [_DPReview_ points out](https://www.dpreview.com/news/adobe-adds-easy-ai-eye-generation-to-lightroom-mobile/), Elements sources the replacement from another phot …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1014246/adobe-lightroom-mobile-ai-quick-action-open-eyes-closed-blink-repair)
